messages:
Maria F: Heads-up — Stripe->NetSuite sync queue stalled since 08:15 UTC. SQS shows ~112 failures with 400 from NS: "Invalid tax_code mapping". Observed after last pricing experiment deploy. Any ideas?
Sam E: Can you paste the SQS/worker logs for one of the failures? Also, did the job start failing at a particular message id?
Maria F: here's a sample payload we sent (sanitized):
```
{"stripe_invoice_id":"in_1Kx...","amount":12000,"tax_code":null,"items":[...],"customer":"cus_ABC"}
```
Sam E: looking at the worker logs: `net_suite_client.create_invoice failed 400 mapping.tax_code missing -> 400` — stack shows mapping-service v2 returned 204 for tax lookup. Suspect mapping-service change dropped default behavior.
Priya R: if payments are captured in Stripe but invoices didn't make it to NS we need a manual mapping workaround ASAP. Can we default tax_code to "STANDARD" and requeue?
Maria F: confirmed: ~98 customer invoices not in NetSuite, payments captured. A few are high-dollar (>$10k). We should consider immediate manual mapping for those.
Nate I: I think this is a regression from the mapping-service rollout last night. I'll roll a patch to treat missing tax_code as "STANDARD" at the NS adapter layer and push a small hotfix. Also adding a dead-letter queue + exponential backoff for the worker so we don't flood NS with bad payloads.
Sam E: +1. Once the hotfix is up, run the requeue script: `scripts/requeue_failed_stripe_sync.py --since 2026-03-22T00:00Z --limit 200` — that should re-attempt with the default tax code. We'll also ensure replays are idempotent by keying on `stripe_invoice_id`.
Maria F: Sounds good. Marking P1. Please advise ETA — customers/accounts team needs to know which invoices are affected.
billing-bot: Requeue job scheduled by sam_e: job_id rjq_20260322_01, estimated 12m runtime. :gear:
Olivia A: Ping on revenue recognition — if invoices didn't land in NS, revenue might be delayed. We should notify external auditors if this affects month-end. Also flag to Collections.
Maria F: Noted. I'll open a ticket for auditor notification and build a list of impacted invoices. Hold any refunds for these customers until we confirm mapping is correct. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
